info.title: AutoSDK.CLI
info.description: Allows you to partially (for example, only models) or completely generate a native (without dependencies) C# client sdk according to the OpenAPI specification. Inspired by NSwag.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: CLI tool to generate .NET SDKs from OpenAPI and AsyncAPI specifications

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generates client SDK code from OpenAPI/AsyncAPI, or scaffolds a C# gRPC project from a local .proto, descriptor set, or Buf module input.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file path [default: Generated]

options.name: --grpc-input
options.description: Additional gRPC/protobuf inputs to scaffold alongside the primary OpenAPI/AsyncAPI generation path. Repeatable. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --api-output-subdirectory
options.description: When using --grpc-input, place the primary OpenAPI/AsyncAPI output under this subdirectory. [default: rest]

options.name: --grpc-output-subdirectory
options.description: When using --grpc-input, place scaffolded gRPC projects under this subdirectory. [default: grpc]

options.name: --targetFramework
options.description: TargetFramework for the generated code [default: net10.0]

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Namespace for the generated code [default: ]

options.name: --clientClassName
options.description: Client class name [default: ]

options.name: --methodNamingConvention
options.description: Method Naming Convention [default: OperationId]

options.name: --single-file
options.description: Generate all models in a single file [default: False]

options.name: --exclude-deprecated-operations
options.description: Exclude deprecated operations [default: False]

options.name: --clsCompliantEnumPrefix
options.description: Prefix for enums which start with a number to make them CLS compliant. Pass empty string to disable prefixing(it will be non-CLS compliant '_') [default: x]

options.name: --identifier-character-set
options.description: Identifier sanitizer mode: Ascii, UnicodeLetters, or CSharpSpec. [default: UnicodeLetters]

options.name: --ignore-openapi-errors
options.description: Ignore OpenAPI errors [default: True]

options.name: --ignore-openapi-warnings
options.description: Ignore OpenAPI warnings [default: True]

options.name: --validation
options.description: Generate validation methods for models [default: False]

options.name: --generate-raw-model-data
options.description: Generate typed raw JSON extension data and raw model helper methods for forward-compatible models. [default: False]

options.name: --compute-discriminators
options.description: Compute discriminators for polymorphic models [default: False]

options.name: --generate-cli
options.description: Generate CLI for the client [default: False]

options.name: --use-system-net-http-json
options.description: Generate System.Text.Json HTTP method bodies via System.Net.Http.Json helpers where safe. [default: False]

options.name: --generate-webhook-verifier
options.description: Generate an opt-in HMAC webhook signature verifier. [default: False]

options.name: --webhook-verifier-class-name
options.description: Class name for the generated webhook verifier. [default: ]

options.name: --webhook-id-header
options.description: Webhook id header name used by the generated verifier. [default: webhook-id]

options.name: --webhook-timestamp-header
options.description: Webhook timestamp header name used by the generated verifier. [default: webhook-timestamp]

options.name: --webhook-signature-header
options.description: Webhook signature header name used by the generated verifier. [default: webhook-signature]

options.name: --webhook-signature-version
options.description: Webhook signature version prefix used by the generated verifier. [default: v1]

options.name: --webhook-timestamp-tolerance-seconds
options.description: Webhook timestamp tolerance in seconds used by the generated verifier. [default: 300]

options.name: --generate-dynamic-multipart-helpers
options.description: Generate opt-in dynamic multipart attachment helper APIs. [default: False]

options.name: --dynamic-multipart-helper-class-name
options.description: Class name for the generated dynamic multipart helper. [default: ]

options.name: --generate-prompt-template-helpers
options.description: Generate opt-in prompt template manager helper APIs. [default: False]

options.name: --prompt-template-helper-class-name
options.description: Class name for the generated prompt template helper. [default: ]

options.name: --generate-observability-lifecycle-helpers
options.description: Generate opt-in observability ingestion lifecycle helper APIs. [default: False]

options.name: --observability-lifecycle-helper-class-name
options.description: Class name for the generated observability lifecycle helper. [default: ]

options.name: --generate-prediction-workflow-helpers
options.description: Generate opt-in prediction/job create-wait-result workflow helper APIs. [default: False]

options.name: --prediction-workflow-helper-class-name
options.description: Class name for the generated prediction workflow helper. [default: ]

options.name: --generate-evaluation-workflow-helpers
options.description: Generate opt-in dataset evaluation and experiment workflow helper APIs. [default: False]

options.name: --evaluation-workflow-helper-class-name
options.description: Class name for the generated evaluation workflow helper. [default: ]

options.name: --generate-cloud-signing-helpers
options.description: Generate opt-in cloud credential and request-signing helper adapters. [default: False]

options.name: --cloud-signing-helper-class-name
options.description: Class name for the generated cloud signing helper factory. [default: ]

options.name: --auto-detect-status-polling
options.description: Auto-emit a polling helper for GET endpoints whose response shape exposes a status enum/const property with a terminal-success state (succeeded/completed/done/finished). [default: False]

options.name: --generate-pageable-helpers
options.description: Emit an AutoSDKPager runtime helper with OffsetAsync and CursorAsync overloads that turn raw page methods into IAsyncEnumerable<TItem> streams. [default: False]

options.name: --security-scheme
options.description: Security scheme as 'Type:Location:Name' (e.g., 'ApiKey:Header:x-api-key', 'Http:Header:Bearer'). Repeatable. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --auth-env-var
options.description: Credential environment variable name for the generated root-client environment factory. Repeatable. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --base-url
options.description: Server base URL to inject (e.g., 'https://api.elevenlabs.io'). Useful for specs missing a servers field. [default: ]

options.name: --base-url-env-var
options.description: Base URL environment variable name for the generated root-client environment factory. Repeatable. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --openapi-override
options.description: OpenAPI override as 'path=action'. Actions: object, dictionary, remove. Repeatable. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --websocket-class-name
options.description: Override class name for the generated WebSocket client (AsyncAPI specs only). For single-channel specs, used as the full class name. For multi-channel specs, used as a prefix (e.g., 'Deepgram' produces 'DeepgramListenV1RealtimeClient'). [default: ]

options.name: --json-serializer-context
options.description: Override the JsonSerializerContext class name (default: SourceGenerationContext). Useful when generating multiple specs to the same project. [default: ]

options.name: --types-namespace
options.description: Namespace to use for type references instead of the main namespace. Used for cross-namespace schema referencing where models live in a different namespace. [default: ]

options.name: --namespace-delimiter
options.description: Optional single-character delimiter for splitting component schema ids into namespaces (for example '.' turns PetStore.Pet into namespace PetStore and class Pet). [default: ]

options.name: --include-models
options.description: Only include these component model ids. Repeatable or pass multiple values. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --exclude-models
options.description: Exclude these component model ids. Repeatable or pass multiple values. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --excluded-model-namespace-mode
options.description: How filtered-out dotted models are referenced when --namespace-delimiter is enabled: External or SdkRoot. [default: External]

options.name: --generate-models
options.description: Generate model classes, enums, and JSON converters. Set to false when referencing types from an existing namespace via --types-namespace. [default: True]

options.name: --language
options.description: Generation backend. Currently supported: csharp. [default: csharp]

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file path [default: Testing]

options.name: --exclude-deprecated-operations
options.description: Exclude deprecated operations [default: False]

options.name: --ignore-openapi-errors

commands.name: cli-project
commands.description: Generates a runnable PackAsTool CLI project for an AutoSDK-generated SDK.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory for the generated CLI project. [default: Cli]

options.name: --sdk-project
options.description: Path to the SDK library .csproj referenced by the generated CLI tool. [default: ]

options.name: --targetFramework
options.description: TargetFramework for the generated CLI project. [default: net10.0]

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Namespace of the referenced SDK. [default: ]

options.name: --clientClassName
options.description: SDK root client class name. [default: ]

options.name: --package-id
options.description: NuGet package id for the generated CLI tool. Defaults to <SdkPackageId>.CLI. [default: ]

options.name: --root-namespace
options.description: Root namespace for generated CLI sources. Defaults to a sanitized package id. [default: ]

options.name: --tool-command-name
options.description: dotnet tool command name. Defaults to tryagi-<sdk-kebab>. [default: ]

options.name: --user-secrets-id
options.description: UserSecretsId used by generated auth runtime. Defaults to a generated stable-looking id. [default: ]

options.name: --api-only
options.description: Generate only self-contained generated api command sources for an existing manual CLI project. [default: False]

options.name: --api-key-env-var
options.description: Environment variable used for API keys. Repeatable. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --base-url-env-var
options.description: Environment variable used for the API base URL. [default: ]

options.name: --exclude-deprecated-operations
options.description: Exclude deprecated operations. [default: False]

options.name: --ignore-openapi-errors
options.description: Ignore OpenAPI errors. [default: True]

options.name: --ignore-openapi-warnings
options.description: Ignore OpenAPI warnings. [default: True]

options.name: --security-scheme
options.description: Security scheme as 'Type:Location:Name' (e.g. 'Http:Header:Bearer'). Repeatable. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --base-url
options.description: Server base URL to inject into specs missing a server. [default: ]

options.name: --openapi-override
options.description: OpenAPI override as 'path=action'. Actions: object, dictionary, remove. Repeatable. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --json-serializer-context
options.description: JsonSerializerContext type name or fully-qualified type used by the SDK. [default: SourceGenerationContext]

arguments.name: INPUT
arguments.description: Input OpenAPI file path or URL. [default: ]

commands.name: sync
commands.description: Syncs README, docs pages, and MkDocs example nav.

options.name: --config

commands.name: convert-to-openapi30

options.name: --output

commands.name: init
commands.description: Creates a new solution with GitHub Actions.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory [default: ]

options.name: --add-mkdocs
options.description: Adds MkDocs to the solution [default: True]

options.name: --add-tests
options.description: Adds integration tests to the solution [default: True]

options.name: --target-framework
options.description: Target framework for publish [default: net10.0]

options.name: --rid

options.name: --verbose

arguments.name: CSPROJ_PATH

commands.name: skill
commands.description: Generate a Claude SKILL.md manifest (optionally multifile) for the generated CLI tool from an OpenAPI spec.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory (multifile mode) or file path ending in `.md` (single-file mode). [default: skill]

options.name: --single-file
options.description: Emit one monolithic SKILL.md with all commands inline, instead of splitting into SKILL.md + commands.md + auth.md. [default: False]

options.name: --package-id
options.description: NuGet package id of the CLI tool (e.g. `tryAGI.OpenAI.CLI`). Used for the dnx command and the skill name.

options.name: --skill-name
options.description: Override the skill `name` field in frontmatter. Defaults to a kebab-cased package id.

options.name: --api-key-env-var
options.description: Name of the environment variable the CLI reads its API key from (e.g. `OPENAI_API_KEY`). Defaults to `<PREFIX>_API_KEY` derived from the package id.

options.name: --homepage
options.description: Optional homepage/repo URL emitted in the footer.

options.name: --exclude-deprecated-operations
options.description: Exclude deprecated operations from the command table. [default: False]
